item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the WA Police response to the two remaining recommendations from its Operation Aviemore investigation.
item.support: The Commission made a commitment to re-evaluate the Police response to the two outstanding recommendations

item.text: Its review included police briefings and observation of investigative interviewing and cultural awareness training.
item.support: Commission officers attended relevant components of two investigative interviewing training courses and a full day Cultural Awareness Training Course

item.text: The Commission concluded that police were addressing the investigation's issues and taking broader steps to change their relationship with Aboriginal people.
item.support: Police are continuing not only to address the issues arising from Operation Aviemore, but have taken a wider approach

item.text: The Commission closed all seven recommendations, while noting continuing challenges in helping interviewees understand the criminal caution.
item.support: The Commission considers that Police have taken responsibility to address all seven recommendations and therefore considers these closed.

item.quote: The Commission considers that Police have taken responsibility to address all seven recommendations and therefore considers these closed.
